selected_evidence.requirement: Rotate /var/log/inventory/app.log daily and retain seven compressed rotations
selected_evidence.summary: The installed rule specifies daily rotation, seven retained archives, and immediate gzip compression. A real rotation created a valid app.log.1.gz, and the main configuration loads the rule.

selected_evidence.requirement: Allow the application to continue writing after rotation
selected_evidence.summary: A writer kept the file open during rotation. The live file and writer descriptor retained inode 894710, while writes continued from the archived marker 30 through live marker 40.

Baseline boot ID was 0305efed-2c0e-4265-b609-10e8259d59a7; reboot was acknowledged; recovered boot ID was 8126dde6-211b-45b0-81df-8ba8a6bb3d1a. The system returned to running state with the timer active, rule loaded, and live/archive data intact.
